source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of positive and negative feedback (PDF 69-70).

blocks.text: Positive feedback mein qaboo karne wale nizam ka banaya hua product ya jawab usi nizam ke amal ko aur tez kar deta hai. Is ki misal posterior pituitary se oxytocin hormone ka chhootna hai. Bachche ki paidaish ke waqt jab uterus (rahim) sukarna (contract hona) shuru karta hai to sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain. Hypothalamus posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai. Oxytocin uterus ko aur zyada aur zyada zor se sukarne par uksata hai. Jab hypothalamus ko zor-daar contractions ka paigham milta hai to woh aur zyada oxytocin chhurwata hai. Positive feedback ka yeh silsila bachche ki paidaish tak chalta rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch numbered khaanon ka chakkar (cycle), teeron se jura: 1 rahim sukarta hai aur sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain; 2 hypothalamus posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai; 3 oxytocin rahim tak pohanch kar mazeed sukarne (contractions) karwata hai; 4 tez sukarne ka paigham hypothalamus tak pohanchta hai; 5 hypothalamus mazeed oxytocin chhurwata hai, aur chakkar phir 1 par aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.7: Oxytocin ka positive feedback (kitab ki Figure 16.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chakkar ko 1 se 5 tak teeron ke saath parhein: 1 uterus sukarta hai aur sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal bhejte hain; 2 hypothalamus posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai; 3 oxytocin uterus ko aur contractions karwata hai; 4 zor-daar contractions ka paigham hypothalamus tak jata hai; 5 hypothalamus aur oxytocin chhurwata hai, aur chakkar phir 1 par aa jata hai. Har chakkar mein asar barhta hai; yeh chakkar sirf bachche ki paidaish par toot'ta hai.

Negative feedback mein aakhri product amal ke pehle qadam ko rok deta hai. Endocrine system mein negative feedback aam hai. Maslan jab khoon ka glucose normal se barh jaye to Islets of Langerhans ke beta cells yeh mehsoos kar ke insulin chhorte hain. Insulin mukhtalif tareeqon se khoon ka glucose kam karta hai, aur khoon ka glucose normal par aa jata hai. Yeh nateeja, yani normal glucose, beta cells ko insulin chhorna band karne ka ishara deta hai. Isi tarah glucagon ka chhootna bhi negative feedback se qaboo hota hai: jab khoon ka glucose kam ho jaye to alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain. Glucagon khoon ka glucose barhata hai, aur glucose normal par aa jata hai. Yeh nateeja, yani normal glucose, alpha cells ko glucagon chhorna band karne ka ishara deta hai.

blocks.alt: Beech ke khaane, Homeostasis: glucose level 90 mg/100mL, ke gird do chakkar. Oopar (ice cream khana): glucose normal se barhta hai, beta cells insulin chhorte hain, jigar (liver) glucose leta hai, glucose normal par aata hai; dashed teer, insulin rokne ka negative feedback, beta cells tak jata hai. Neeche (khana chhorna): glucose normal se girta hai, alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain, jigar glycogen tor kar glucose banata hai, glucose normal par aata hai; dashed teer glucagon rokta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.8: Insulin aur glucagon ka negative feedback (kitab ki Figure 16.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chakkar beech ke khaane (normal glucose 90 mg/100mL) se shuru ho kar wahin wapas aata hai. Khoon ke laal gol khaakon mein safaid nuqte glucose hain: zyada nuqte matlab zyada glucose. Laal dashed teer hi negative feedback hai: jab glucose normal par aa jata hai to yahi nateeja beta cells ko insulin, ya alpha cells ko glucagon, chhorna band karne ka paigham deta hai. Yani aakhri nateeja amal ke pehle qadam ko rok deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ne saara din test ki tayyari ki aur nashta aur dopahar ka khana chhor diya. Kaunsa hormone barhega, aur feedback us ka chhootna kaise band karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Khoon ka glucose kam hone se alpha cells glucagon zyada chhorte hain. Glucagon jigar ka glycogen tor kar glucose khoon mein lata hai. Jab glucose normal par aa jata hai to yahi normal satah alpha cells ko glucagon chhorna band karne ka ishara deti hai (negative feedback).

items: Positive feedback: nateeja amal ko aur tez karta hai; misal: paidaish ke waqt oxytocin aur uterus ke contractions, jo bachche ki paidaish tak barhte rehte hain.
Negative feedback: nateeja amal ka pehla qadam rok deta hai; misal: glucose zyada ho to insulin, kam ho to glucagon, aur glucose normal hote hi dono ka chhootna band.
